foundationPr.body:
## Summary

Live checks on October 20 found CloudFront function-generated 301 responses on both legacy hosts. This PR makes publishing controlled and repeatable, and maps /about to the existing Health /work page instead of a missing destination.

- Add a manual-only, main-only workflow using the production environment and the existing OIDC pattern.
- Back up DEVELOPMENT and LIVE code/configuration plus distribution configuration before mutation; require successful artifact upload.
- Verify alias ownership and all viewer-request associations, test DEVELOPMENT, and publish only the tested version with a fresh ETag.
- Verify all six required URLs with curl, including final 200 destinations, with a ten-minute propagation limit.
- Remove hardcoded resource identifiers from the redirect documentation. Preserve existing CB-CAP, method, host and private-query protections.

## Owner configuration

Create repository variables:
- LEGACY_HEALTH_DISTRIBUTION_ID
- LEGACY_HEALTH_FUNCTION_NAME
- LEGACY_HEALTH_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN
- AWS_REGION (optional, default us-east-1)

If absent from the existing role, add cloudfront:GetDistribution scoped to the configured distribution and cloudfront:DescribeFunction, cloudfront:GetFunction, cloudfront:UpdateFunction, cloudfront:TestFunction and cloudfront:PublishFunction scoped to the configured function. OIDC trust must permit subject repo:drolu-cmyk/sozorock-foundation:environment:production with audience sts.amazonaws.com. IAM access was not available for inspection; this PR creates no IAM resources.

The separate drolu-cmyk/sozorock-ai-lab workflow complete-foundation-production-recovery.yml manages legacy Amplify recovery and still expects 308. Its owner must align those checks to 301 and reconcile domain ownership before running it. That repository is unchanged. No Amplify permissions are needed for the observed CloudFront path.

## Reviewer checklist

- [x] Redirect tests pass as part of npm run test:sites (57 tests passed).
- [ ] Confirm /about → https://health.sozorockfoundation.org/work is the intended legacy mapping.
- [ ] Verify repository variables, bounded role permissions and production environment protections.
- [ ] Review backup, ETag change detection, DEVELOPMENT tests and rollback instructions.
- [ ] Align the conflicting recovery workflow in the other repository before any future recovery.
- [ ] After a separate approved publish, verify /, /about and /cb-cap on both hosts return 301 and final pages return 200.

## Manual fallback

- CloudFront: Console → CloudFront → Functions → the legacy Health viewer-request function → back up the current code/configuration → paste the repo source → Save → Test → Publish.
- Amplify, only if confirmed to be serving the hosts: Console → the legacy Health app → Hosting → Rewrites and redirects → back up the rules → change 302 to 301, preserving the CB-CAP rule.

This is a draft for review. No merge, deployment or publishing workflow run has been performed. At commit cd43082, the Foundation CI run passed installation, build, all 57 site tests (including legacy redirect tests), AWS release validation, production and agent dependency audits, restricted deployment/rollback tests and workflow YAML validation. The workflow allowlist includes the new manual publisher; unrelated checks remain unchanged.

Verification: https://github.com/drolu-cmyk/sozorock-foundation/actions/runs/39469998597
